name: AL PoC: Shipping Agent (resolve Ship-To and cut-off)

nodes.name: StartShippingAgent
nodes.notes: Inputs: order_id, sender_email, customer_name, sold_to_hint, ship_to = {code, name, street, city, postal_code, country}, requested_delivery_date

options.systemMessage: You are the Shipping Agent for Air Liquide packaged-gas order intake. Identify the customer account (Sold-To) and the delivery address (Ship-To) for one order, using only the tools. Steps: (1) call find_account_by_email with the sender email; if it returns no account, answer match=not_found. (2) call list_ship_to_for_account with the sold_to_code and compare the customer's delivery address and Ship-To code against the rows: street, city, postal code, or an explicit Ship-To code. (3) call get_cutoff with the account's sales_org and plant. 'exact' means the customer gave a Ship-To code or an address that matches one row unambiguously; 'resolved' means one row matches on city plus street or name; 'ambiguous' means two or more rows could match (list them in candidates); 'not_found' means no row matches. Never invent codes: sold_to_code and ship_to_code must be values a tool returned, or empty strings. Return the JSON the output format requires and nothing else.

nodes.name: ShippingAgentModel
nodes.notes: Lab model. Customer instance: Gemini on Air Liquide's own API key or Vertex AI, by replacing this sub-node.

parameters.toolDescription: Find the customer account (Sold-To) from the sender's email address. Matches the contact email or the email domain. Returns sold_to_code, name, email_domain, contact_email, sales_org, plant; no rows when unknown.
parameters.query:
select sold_to_code, name, email_domain, contact_email, sales_org, plant from al_poc.accounts
where lower(contact_email) = lower($1) or lower(email_domain) = lower(split_part($1, '@', 2));

parameters.toolDescription: List the delivery addresses (Ship-To partner roles) allowed for a Sold-To account. Returns ship_to_code, name, street, city, postal_code, country for each.
parameters.query:
select ship_to_code, name, street, city, postal_code, country from al_poc.partner_roles
where sold_to_code = $1 and role = 'SH' order by ship_to_code;

parameters.toolDescription: Get the daily order cut-off time for a sales organisation and plant (the Omnichannel Backend rule). Returns cutoff_local_time and tz.
parameters.query:
select sales_org, plant, cutoff_local_time::text as cutoff_local_time, tz from al_poc.cut_offs
where sales_org = $1 and plant = $2;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $fromAI('sales_org', 'sales_org of the account, e.g. FR01', 'string') }},{{ $fromAI('plant', 'plant of the account, e.g. FR07', 'string') }}

nodes.name: ShippingParserFixerModel
nodes.notes: Second model call only when the agent's JSON does not match the schema.

nodes.name: VerifyShipTo

parameters.query:
select p.sold_to_code, p.ship_to_code, p.name, p.city, a.sales_org, a.plant, c.cutoff_local_time::text as cutoff_local_time, c.tz
from al_poc.partner_roles p
join al_poc.accounts a on a.sold_to_code = p.sold_to_code
left join al_poc.cut_offs c on c.sales_org = a.sales_org and c.plant = a.plant
where p.sold_to_code = $1 and p.ship_to_code = $2 and p.role = 'SH';

nodes.notes: Deterministic check: the chosen Ship-To must be a partner role of the chosen Sold-To.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('StartShippingAgent').first().json.order_id, $execution.id, 'shipping_agent', 'ShippingAgent', 'Shipping Agent match=' + (($('ResolveShipToWithAgent').first().json.output || {}).match || 'none'), JSON.stringify({ output: $('ResolveShipToWithAgent').first().json.output, steps: ($('ResolveShipToWithAgent').first().json.intermediateSteps || []).map(s => ({ tool: s.action?.tool, input: s.action?.toolInput })) })] }}

parameters.content:
## 1. Shipping Agent

Called with the sender email, the customer name and the delivery address as written. Tools: find the Sold-To by email, list its Ship-To partner roles, read the plant cut-off (OCB). Structured output only; codes must come from a tool result.

## 2. Deterministic verify and log

The chosen Ship-To must be a partner of the chosen Sold-To, re-read from the table. The cut-off is evaluated in the plant's time zone and the earliest dispatch date computed. Tool calls go to step_log.
